itemized.notes:
PAGE-FACE candidate 'Cary R. McConnell', party 'Republican', Office Seeking written out in full as 'Utah County Treasurer', residence city abbreviated by the filer as 'Sp Fork' (Spanish Fork) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face fills an empty channel label.

⚠⚠ THE REPORT TYPE, READ FROM THE CHECKED BOX — AND IT IS NOT WHAT THE CHANNEL CALLS IT. The 'Type of Report' block has a check mark against the FIRST option, '30 Days after withdraw or elimination', and every other box — including 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election', '30 Days after the Primary Election', 'Seven days preceding the General Election' and '30 Days after the General Election' — is empty. THIS IS A WITHDRAWAL REPORT. The channel labels the row 'Post Primary - McConnell' and the county's own filename is `2014_PostPrimary-McConnell.pdf`; the page face governs and the divergence is left visible. This independently CONFIRMS the module's gap ledger, which already records this filing as a withdrawal report, and it is confirmed from the checked box itself and not adopted from that ledger. The amendment question is answered 'No'. Cover signature date 7/25/14, matching the p2 Date-of-Report box; the clerk's received stamp reads JUL 25 PM 5:45.

⚠ AND THE FILER CONTRADICTS HIS OWN COVER ON HIS OWN SHEETS: both pp3-4 are subtitled '(30 days after Primary)' in his own type, while his cover checks the withdrawal box. Both readings are recorded and NEITHER IS ADJUDICATED. The most likely account — that he withdrew after the primary and reused his previous sheet headings — is an inference, not a reading, and is not acted on. It does explain how the county's channel label came to say 'Post Primary'.

4 PDF pages: p1 the county's COVER (the common 2014 blank, '...FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES'), p2 the county's SUMMARY PAGE (the Column A / Column B grid, handwritten), then pp3-4 the FILER'S OWN TYPED SHEETS substituted for Schedule A and Schedule B — the same cover-plus-summary-plus-own-schedules shape as his June filing `b80b5798`, and in the SAME order (contributions p3, expenditures p4), not reversed. Every page was classified from its own printed header. FOLIATION: 'Page 2 of 4' handwritten on the county summary page and 'Page 3 of 4' / 'Page 4 of 4' typed on the filer's own sheets, counting the cover — an internally consistent 4-sheet document, complete as filed.

THE LADDER CLOSES COMPLETELY AND IS PERIOD-SCOPED THROUGHOUT: line 3 152.79 + line 4 3,180.30 = line 5 3,333.09, minus line 6 3,333.09 = line 7, a slashed zero read as 0 under the zero-glyph ruling. Column B carries 13,180.30 on BOTH line 1 and line 2 — the filer's cycle-to-date contributions and expenditures genuinely coincide at that figure — and neither was summed as an increment. NOTE: line 3's 152.79 equals the closing balance of this filer's June filing `b80b5798`; that is an observation about the chain, NOT a reconciliation, and NO TWO COVERS WERE DIFFERENCED anywhere in this record — both sides are gated on this filing's own Column A and on each ledger's own printed total.

SELF-FUNDING: the entire 3,180.30 raised this period is the candidate's own money, in a single row, and the campaign closes at zero. As on his June filing, no row uses the word 'loan' and no loan treatment is needed — line 3 already carries a real non-zero beginning balance, so the self-money can only be a contribution.

THE FILER'S OWN COLUMN HEADINGS ARE HIS OWN: 'Contributor' / 'Location' / 'Amount' on Schedule A and 'Expense' / 'Location' / 'Amount' on Schedule B. 'Expense' heads the PAYEE column; the columns were assigned by content, not by the heading's wording. One 'Location' cell names a COUNTY ('Utah County, Utah') rather than a city.

PRIVACY: published UNREDACTED. The candidate's own street address and phone number are visible on the cover and are NOT carried here in any field or note. The schedules themselves carry NO street lines at all — the filer's 'Location' column prints city and state only — so the contribution row reproduces exactly what the document gives (city plus the state written out as 'Utah', kept verbatim) and nothing had to be reduced.
